description: A 60-item written test developed by Ghorbani to assess Iranian undergraduate EFL learners' identification of primary word stress in two-, three-, and four-syllable English words drawn from BBC The Flatmates lesson scripts.
title: 60-item word stress identification test based on The Flatmates episodes

description: A dataset of 199 official Japanese occupational-therapy licensing-exam questions, including text-only, visually based, and case-based items, released and used by Saita Kazuya et al.
title: 60th Japanese National Examination for Occupational Therapists (2025) multimodal benchmark dataset
